dedupe_keys.name: data set for publication extended sindicomp characterizing mv voltage transformers with sine waves

description: Gabriella Crotti and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. This XLSX deposit supplies data for Tables 2 and 4 and Figure 10a of the Extended SINDICOMP study in Energies 14:1715. The paper concerns characterising medium-voltage transformers using sine waves. Coverage is the specified published results, not all instrument recordings or a downloadable executable model. The dataset supports power-quality model calibration and comparison, while exact columns, sweep settings and uncertainty details are not in the native abstract. Other SINDICOMP publications describe related methods without establishing identical experimental observations. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
